name: Material Availability Board
summary: Read-only ShipRec analysis tool that lets users search by warehouse location or part number and review per-part stock cards, current positive-quantity locations, rolled-up incoming material, and the associated parent parts that are due to run next using Infor Visual work-order demand.

userActions: Resolve fuzzy matches for locations or parts
Expand a card to review detailed stock and inbound material
Review rolled-up incoming material for the selected look-ahead window
Review which associated parent parts are due to run next
preserveRules: Keep all Infor Visual access read-only
Keep warehouse scope explicit for location validation and stock queries
Keep cards collapsed by default after every new search
Keep part-level aggregation logic in the ShipRec tool service rather than in code-behind
acceptanceCriteria: Location searches create one card per unique part in the selected location
Part-number searches still return a card when the part has no current positive-quantity locations
Each card shows all positive-quantity locations for the part within the current warehouse scope
Incoming material is rolled up across qualifying part-matched lines even when due dates are missing
Associated part rows show the best available next due-to-run date per parent part
Cards start collapsed on initial load and after each search
validationHints: Confirm location and part search modes each resolve fuzzy matches before loading results
Confirm cards are sorted by the earliest associated part run date before cards with no run data
Confirm quantity display is rounded for UI only while aggregation still uses decimal values
Confirm incoming material still appears when active PO lines have no qualifying due date fields
Confirm changing the look-ahead selector between 30, 60, 90, and All updates both incoming material and associated part results
Confirm whole-collection card replacement resets expansion state after a new search
